headline: Lenovo confirms Legion Go issues after gamers report bricked devices
summary: Gamers report Legion Go devices were bricked following a software update. Lenovo acknowledges the issues affecting its handheld gaming PCs. Uncertainty remains regarding free repair policies for affected users.

headline: The cat-and-mouse game over 3D-printed guns has begun
summary: The creator of the first 3D-printed gun claims to have bypassed government software blocks. This marks an escalating battle between regulators and individuals creating ghost guns. Authorities aim to stem the flow, while creators seek workarounds.

headline: Zillow and Redfin settle FTC antitrust case over their rental listings partnership
summary: The FTC and Zillow have settled an antitrust case concerning a 2025 Zillow-Redfin partnership. FTC alleged Zillow paid Redfin to syndicate listings and avoid competition. Redfin reportedly ended its advertising contracts as part of the agreement.

headline: Robotaxis are real now — so is the pushback
summary: Robotaxis are expanding, but face increasing resistance over operational rules. New York Gov. Hochul withdrew a robotaxi proposal after strong opposition. Commercial driverless service remains illegal in New York six months later.

headline: Newegg Has the Least Overpriced 32GB of DDR5 6000MHz CL 30 Desktop Memory
summary: Newegg offers competitively priced 32GB of DDR5 6000MHz CL 30 desktop memory. This RAM is considered ideal for AMD Ryzen-based gaming builds. Gamers can find a cost-effective upgrade for their PC.

headline: Get a 1,000W 48V Adult Electric Bike With 28mph Top Speed and 80 Mile Range for Just $275 Shipped
summary: A powerful 1,000W 48V adult electric bike is available for only $275, including shipping. The bike boasts a 28mph top speed and an impressive 80-mile range. It's marketed as an efficient and fast commuting option.

headline: The Witcher 3 Songs of the Past Expansion Confirmed to Include More Gwent, and Everyone Is Already Celebrating
summary: CD Projekt Red confirms more Gwent will be featured in The Witcher 3's upcoming expansion. The 'Songs of the Past' expansion excites card game lovers. Fans are celebrating the news of expanded Gwent content.

headline: The FlashForge AD5X Multi-Color 3D Printer Drops to Just $203 Shipped at AliExpress
summary: The FlashForge AD5X Multi-Color 3D Printer is now available for $203 on AliExpress. This deal offers significant savings compared to its $350 price on Amazon. It's a notable opportunity for hobbyists to acquire a multi-color 3D printer.

headline: Organised crime arrests as police investigate A66 crash that killed two officers
summary: Nine men and three women have been arrested following an A66 crash. Police are investigating the lead-up to the collision that killed seven people. Two police officers were among the fatalities in the incident.

headline: How the deadly A66 crash unfolded leaving seven dead
summary: Two police officers died when their marked car collided with a Volkswagen Passat. The incident occurred on the A66 motorway at 03:30 BST on Saturday. The crash tragically resulted in a total of seven fatalities.

headline: Burnham vows support for Ukraine despite 'outrageous threats' from Russia
summary: Andy Burnham pledges continued support for Ukraine amid Russian threats. Moscow issued warnings of 'consequences' over reported use of British drones. Burnham stands firm against what he calls 'outrageous threats.'

headline: Beyond China's humanoid robots, a quieter machine revolution is unfolding
summary: China is experiencing a rapid, quieter machine revolution within its factories. Over two million robots are currently at work across Chinese manufacturing. This trend signifies a massive scaling up of industrial automation.
